Typhoon Rolly is over, the Philippines won over those who wish ill for our countrymen. Oo malakas ang bagyo, nagbaon ng daan daang bahay sa lahar, bato putik at baha, casualties as of yesterday after noon is less than a hundred. It only proves that a TV station is not saving the lives of the many. It is a working government with proper coordination of national and local government. Sa mga naghahanap sa pangulo, the government is working days way before the landfall. The government did not stop working and the results shows it was effectively managed. Hindi kailangan umipal ni Pres. Duterte katulad ni Mar na magpabasa sa ulan, did Mar save thousands of lives because of his presence? No he did not.

Around 96,000 families or more than 346,000 people were in evacuation centers in the Bicol region. On Saturday, Oct. 31, the NDRRMC said about a million people were evacuated due to the coming super typhoon, yan ang nagsalba sa mga tao. Tunay na leadership hindi kaepalan.
